title: Produktmanager Tourismus (m/w/d)
description:
Du kennst die Touristik, entwickelst mit Leidenschaft neue Reiseideen und hast ein Gespür für besondere Reiseerlebnisse? Dann bring deine Erfahrung im Produktmanagement ein, gestalte unser Reiseportfolio aktiv mit und entwickle gemeinsam mit uns neue Reiseformate.
WIR SUCHEN AB SOFORT IN VOLLZEIT
PRODUKTMANAGER TOURISMUS (M/W/D)
 OSNABRÜCK
 BERLIN
 HYBRIDES ARBEITEN MÖGLICH
 Wir bei M-TOURS Erlebnisreisen sind ein etablierter und qualitätsorientierter Reiseveranstalter mit einer großen Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Reiseerlebnisse. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Organisation hochwertiger Gruppenreisen für die anspruchsvolle Zielgruppe der Best Ager sowie der Konzeption exklusiver Leserreisen in Zusammenarbeit mit renommierten Medienhäusern. In unserem erfahrenen und engagierten Team pflegen wir eine Kultur der offenen Kommunikation und kurzer Entscheidungswege. Nun befinden wir uns in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und suchen dich, um mit Kreativität und strategischem Weitblick unser Produktportfolio zu erweitern und unsere Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.
 So Bringst Du Dich Ein
 Produktmanagement: Du verantwortest die Planung, Konzeption, Kalkulation und Durchführung unserer Reisen – von der ersten Idee bis zur Nachbereitung. 
 Produktentwicklung: Mit kreativen Ideen entwickelst du unser Portfolio für Best Ager und Leserreisen weiter und konzipierst neue, zielgruppengerechte Reiseformate. 
 Strategische Weiterentwicklung: Du analysierst Markt- und Reisetrends, identifizierst neue Potenziale und wirkst am Aufbau neuer Produktlinien mit. 
 Touristischer Einkauf: Du wählst internationale Partner aus, verhandelst Konditionen mit Hotels, Agenturen und Airlines und organisierst weitere Reiseleistungen. 
 Qualitätsmanagement: Entlang der gesamten Reisekette stellst du unsere Qualitätsstandards sicher und nutzt Kunden-feedback zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung. 
 Schnittstellenmanagement: Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Vertrieb erstellst du überzeugende Reiseausschreibungen für Kataloge, Website und Newsletter. 
 Das Bringst Du Mit
 Qualifikation: Du hast ein touristisches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung (z. B. als Tourismuskauffrau/-mann) abgeschlossen. 
 Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement eines Reiseveranstalters sowie Kenntnisse der Zielgruppe Best Ager zeichnen dich aus. 
 Produktkompetenz: Du entwickelst mit Kreativität und Gespür für Reisetrends neue Produktideen und hast idealerweise bereits Leserreisen konzipiert. 
 Verhandlungsgeschick: Du überzeugst mit Verhandlungsstärke, Kalkulationssicherheit und einem ausgeprägten kaufmännischen Verständnis. 
 Arbeitsweise: Organisationstalent, Eigeninitiative und strategisches Denken zeichnen dich ebenso aus wie ein sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und idealerweise touristischer Software. 
 Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil. 
 Das Bieten Wir Dir
 Flexibilität
Vertrauensarbeitszeit, hybrides Arbeiten und bis zu 4 Wochen Workation pro Jahr innerhalb Europas.
Vergünstigungen
Schnäppchen ab dem ersten Arbeitstag und Zugang zu Angeboten der Tourismusbranche.
Weiterbildung
Interne Lernplattform, Trainings, Workshops und individuelle Angebote.
Familie
Raum für Familie und Beruf durch Sonderurlaubstage und Kitazuschuss.
Verpflegung
Ob leckerer Kaffee oder spritziges Wasser - bei uns sitzt niemand auf dem Trockenen.
Gesundheit
Betriebsärztliche Angebote, Grippeschutz und regelmäßige Augenuntersuchungen.
Altersvorsorge
Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen.
Firmenfitness
Mit EGYM Wellpass oder Epassi tausende Sport- und Wellnessangebote nutzen.
HABEN WIR DICH ÜBERZEUGT?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Product manager in integrations and AI foundations
description:

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more) 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office) Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year A great tech and work setup Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

title: Product manager for billing and payment platforms
description:
Описание:
Rabot Energy is an independent provider of dynamic electricity tariffs for households and businesses. With smart purchasing strategies and automatic control, we shift flexible consumption to hours with low wholesale prices. This helps households and businesses optimize their electricity costs. Our vision is to give all customers the opportunity to control their electricity consumption smartly and benefit from low-cost wholesale hours.
Задачи:
You are responsible as Product Manager for the billing, payment and pricing platform and therefore for the complete user and data journey from customer onboarding to billing: billing processes and data flows, price components, advance payments, bill runs, billing documents, payment collection and mandate logic, dunning and receivables processes, installment payments and billing-related customer communication. Your fundamental mission is platform development. You build on this foundation, deciding which requirements become reusable platform capabilities and shaping the architecture for the coming years. You own the domain end to end. You prioritize with a dedicated development team, write PRDs, refine with Engineering and launch releases- from individual price corrections to multi-month platform initiatives. You make billing understandable. You work to ensure that customers understand their bill, advance payment and credit without having to ask. You own Payrate and Open Balance. You are responsible for the product levers that affect payment collection: automated dunning stages, automatic allocation of payments and credits (oldest receivable first), retry and mandate logic for payment collection, and installment payments. You manage Payrate and Open Balance as metrics in their own right, not as a by-product of billing. You build a platform, not just features. You are responsible for billing and payment services, and pricing and billing APIs—the building blocks that other teams and partners build on—and decide deliberately when a requirement should become a platform capability and when it should not. You enable new business models. The ability to bill them determines whether live marketing of EVs and battery storage, heating and night-storage tariffs, and other models succeed or fail. You navigate regulation and the energy market. You translate regulatory requirements into actionable product decisions. You work AI-first. We use AI tools for analysis, documentation, data checks and recurring processes. We expect you to use them to speed up your own workflow, rather than wait for someone to build a tool for you. You work closely with Engineering, Customer Support, Operations, Finance/Controlling, BI, Legal, Partner Management, Sales and the other Product Squads, and report transparently to the team and Leadership every week.
Требования:
This role combines two worlds: numbers and people. You work with complex pricing, billing and payment logic every day, but you succeed above all by bringing people together: Support, Finance, Engineering, partners and Leadership. If you have studied business administration, economics, industrial engineering or engineering, or come from consulting, and feel at home in both worlds, you are likely to be a great fit, even if your previous title was not "Product Manager". People first: You build trust across teams, listen before making decisions and bring stakeholders with different interests to the table. You explain complex matters so that Support, Finance and Leadership can understand them. Excellent German and English skills are essential. Professional experience: You have around 2-4 years of professional experience- ideally as a Product Owner or Product Manager for a digital product, where you independently delivered with a development team, from discovery through PRD and refinement to release. Experience in consulting, finance, controlling or analytics, where you structured complex problems and implemented solutions together with others, is equally welcome. You think in lifecycles, not tickets. You consider the product across the entire customer lifecycle—from the first price on the website through contract changes to the final bill and payment receipt. You look beyond your own domain, understand what upstream and downstream teams need, and make decisions that will still hold up in two years. Numbers and complex systems are your world: You handle price components, advance payments and receivables with confidence; rules, edge cases, data models and process logic interest you more than they stress you. You investigate problems down to their root cause instead of treating symptoms, formulate sound hypotheses and use data tools to analyze your own numbers wherever possible. Pragmatism under deadlines: You prioritize rigorously, communicate risks early and find robust, pragmatic solutions. Attention to detail matters greatly to you, but you do not get lost in it. AI-native: You use AI tools as a matter of course for analysis, documentation, specification and automating your own work. Будет плюсом: Experience in the energy industry: market communication, metering point operations, EPEX spot prices, Section 14a EnWG, MsbG, EEG, smart meters / iMSys; Experience with billing, invoicing or payment systems- payment service providers, mandates, dunning, installment payments, receivables management is a significant plus; Experience with platform or API products and internal customers; A basic understanding of statistics and experiment design for A/B tests
Условия:
Ownership: You are responsible for the company's backbone, with a direct impact on customer trust, support costs and retention. A well-organized start: documented domain, ongoing PRDs, established steering and reporting formats, and a structured handover. You will not be starting in the dark. Structured handover: You start with co-ownership during the first 3-6 months and gradually take over full responsibility for the domain. Visibility: Your work touches almost

title: (Senior) Technical Program Manager - M&A Integration (m/f/d) - Berlin
description:
Location : Come and join us in Hamburg or Berlin!
 Following Lyft’s acquisition of Freenow, we are looking for a Senior TPM to lead the technical workstreams that get us to Day 1 readiness — the period between signing and closing — and to set up the integration that follows. This is a high-stakes, high-visibility role reporting into the EU Tech Leader, with direct exposure to Freenow and Lyft leadership.
You will be the single point of accountability for technical Day 1 readiness. That means making sure every employee, every office, and every critical system is ready to operate underFreenow by Lyft from the moment the deal closes — and that the integration stream is up and running the day after. You will also be the TPM accountable for the integration of future acquisitions Freenow makes.
This is not a role for someone who wants to administer a project plan. You are expected to be technically credible, opinionated, and comfortable holding senior people to account across IT, Security, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, People, and Finance. You make decisions when others stall, escalate cleanly when you can’t, and keep the whole machine moving.
 YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:
 Day 1 readiness. Own the end-to-end technical readiness plan between signing and closing. Define what “ready” means, track every workstream against it, and call the go/no-go on technical readiness for Day 1.
 IT and workplace cutover. Coordinate identity and system access (SSO, IdP, mail, productivity suite, engineering tooling), hardware provisioning and re-imaging, and office setup including network, VPN, Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, and physical access. Make sure nobody shows up on Day 1 unable to work.
 Security and compliance posture. Partner with Security and Legal to make sure the technical environment meets the new shareholder’s requirements on Day 1 — access controls, data handling, audit trails, vendor relationships.
 Integration stream kickoff. Stand up the technical integration workstreams between Freenow and Lyft so they are running, staffed, and producing output from day one of the integration phase. Set the operating cadence, dependencies, and escalation paths.
 Cross-functional orchestration. Hold IT, SRE, Infrastructure, Platform, Product Engineering, Data, Security, People, Legal, and Finance together on a single plan. Push hard on dependencies. Surface risks before they become incidents.
 Executive communication. Produce the technical readiness narrative for Freenow leadership, Lyft leadership, and the integration steering committee. Honest, concise, decision-oriented.
 Future M&A. Codify what you learn into a repeatable M&A integration playbook so we can do this faster and better the next time Freenow acquires a company.
 TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:
 Significant TPM, engineering management, or M&A integration experience, with a clear track record of delivering on M&A separation, integration, or carve-out programmes — ideally including a Day 1 cutover under a new owner.
 A strong technical foundation — software engineering or infrastructure background. You can sit in an architecture review and push back credibly, and you understand what it takes to operate large-scale, 24x7 production systems.
 Working knowledge of enterprise IT and corporate engineering: identity providers and SSO, MDM, endpoint management, networking and VPN, SaaS provisioning, source control and CI/CD tooling, cloud account structures.
 Comfort operating in extreme ambiguity with only high-level direction, across multiple jurisdictions, time zones, and corporate cultures.
 Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can brief a C-level audience in three slides and an engineer in a Slack thread, and adjust the register without losing precision.
 Influence without authority. You get senior people to commit, deliver, and stay aligned in a matrixed environment — without needing a reporting line to do it.
 Calm under pressure. M&A timelines move, regulators ask questions, and things break. You stay structured and keep others structured.
 Nice to have:
 Previous experience inside a regulated business (mobility, fintech, payments) or working through a change-of-control event.
 Familiarity with the German labour and works council context.
 Exposure to both acquirer-side and target-side integration work.
 BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:
 Flexible working arrangements
 LinkedIn Learning
 Sabbatical & special leave policies
 WeRoad partnership
 Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
 Short term EU work policy
 Mobility Credit
 Health Insurance
 Employee assistance program
 DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:
 Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.
We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work. 
 ABOUT US:
 Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.
In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?
